notes.content:

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Practice Mode / New Slingshot
notes.content:
[h1] Practice Mode [/h1]

Due that shooting by slingshot 1st time is not thay easy and that physic of shooting is changing  we decided to add few archery targets on map which you can practice on. There are classic mode and time mode with personal best time.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30532474/4ee625d586fa3feabe6b3af36677eeee9b3c8530.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30532474/b93fe360c94fd61a11dd83fbd40b9c30ad59c31e.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Slingshot [/h1]

This time we focused on visual aspect of game, main weapon - Slingshot, got a new high quality model. In addition, the new model has a different set of bones that can affect the physics of shooting over which you have to practice a little (in practice mode). Hope u enjoy new look.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30532474/72db2ad13f0c4f08cfd81524ed9755a26195bfcc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Demon Cyclop
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30532474/cfa8406dd2a148af6646ed3e872446115793c124.jpg[/img]

New monster has been added to the game. Its Cyclop with his might mace going around the castle and targeting barrciades and castles gates. There is also possibility to add an option to atack player if it is within his range. Demon is coming every 5 waves randomly from forest or mountain path. Watch out for his mighty mace, which inflicts much damage !

Also in this update:
* added dust animation after killing skeleton
* minor change of bullet release from a sling
